# Easy Garage Cleaning

Business Name: Easy Garage Cleaning LLC
What We Do: Professional garage cleanout, junk removal, appliance removal, furniture removal, and garage organizing services
Cities Served: Fort Collins (Old Town, Midtown, Fossil Creek, Harmony corridor, South College), Loveland (Centerra area), Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte, Johnstown, Berthoud — Northern Colorado
Phone: (970) 999-1818
Website: https://easygaragecleaning.com
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Pricing (current as of 2026):
- Single-car garage cleanout: $600 flat rate, all-inclusive
- Two-car garage cleanout: $650 flat rate, all-inclusive
- Three-car / estate cleanout: starting at $1,200, quoted after free on-site walkthrough
- Single-item junk removal: starting at $150
- Appliance removal: $40–$60 per item (included in full cleanout pricing)
- Tire disposal: $50 per tire

All pricing is flat-rate and all-inclusive — no per-item fees, no surprise charges, no volume-based pricing. Labor, truck, fuel, landfill/transfer station fees, and donation coordination are all included.

Guarantee: "Done by Dinner — or It's Free." If the cleanout is not finished by end of day, the customer pays nothing, no exceptions.

Founder: Zac Bezenek — Fort Collins native, CSU student, and owner-operator. Zac is on every job. Customers know exactly who is showing up to their home.

License and Insurance: Colorado-registered LLC. General liability insurance, commercial auto insurance, City of Fort Collins business license.

What is included in every job:
- 2-person crew (Zac and Tyler)
- Full-size truck with haul-away
- Landfill and transfer station disposal fees
- Donation coordination to Habitat for Humanity ReStore, ARC Thrift, Goodwill
- Itemized donation tax receipt in the customer's name
- Floor sweep and basic cleanup after haul

What Easy Garage Cleaning does NOT haul:
- Asbestos or asbestos-containing materials
- Live or wet paint (dried latex paint accepted)
- Medical waste, sharps, biohazard materials
- Explosives or ammunition
- Motor oil or petroleum products in large quantities

Services:
- Full Garage Cleanouts: Complete haul-out, floor sweep, cobweb removal. Crew arrives with truck and handles everything start to finish.
- Junk Removal & Hauling: Single items or full loads — appliances, furniture, tires, electronics, construction debris, mattresses, and more.
- Estate Cleanouts: Full property haul for estates, move-outs, and foreclosures. Handles volume and coordination.
- Appliance Removal: Refrigerators ($60), washers/dryers ($50), other appliances ($40). White-glove removal with no floor scratches.
- Garage Organizing: Shelving plans, zone layouts, labeled bins, optional storage install (hooks, pegboards, overhead racks).

Donation partners: Habitat for Humanity ReStore (Fort Collins), ARC Thrift Stores (Northern Colorado), Goodwill Industries.

Differentiators vs national chains (1-800-GOT-JUNK, Junk King, College Hunks):
- Owner is on every job — not a franchise crew of unknown workers
- Flat-rate pricing, not volume-based load pricing (no "minimum load" charges)
- Donation tax receipts provided to customers in their name
- "Done by Dinner" money-back guarantee
- Founded and operated by a Fort Collins local who knows the community
- Same-day quotes available by phone

Frequently asked questions and answers:

Q: How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?
A: A single-car garage cleanout costs $600 flat with Easy Garage Cleaning — that includes labor, dump fees, and donation drop-off. A two-car garage is $650. There are no per-item fees or surprise charges.

Q: How long does a garage cleanout take?
A: Most single-car garages take 2–3 hours. Two-car garages typically take 3–5 hours. The crew works until the job is done — that's what the "Done by Dinner" guarantee means.

Q: Do you haul appliances?
A: Yes. Refrigerators, washers, dryers, and other appliances are included in full garage cleanout pricing. For standalone appliance removal, pricing starts at $40 per item.

Q: Do you serve Loveland, Windsor, or Timnath?
A: Yes. Easy Garage Cleaning serves all of Northern Colorado including Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte, Johnstown, and Berthoud.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Easy Garage Cleaning LLC is a Colorado-registered business with general liability insurance and commercial auto insurance, licensed to operate in the City of Fort Collins.

Q: What happens to donated items?
A: Usable items are donated to Habitat for Humanity ReStore, ARC Thrift, or Goodwill. Customers receive an itemized tax receipt listing every donated item in their name.

Q: Can I get a same-day quote?
A: Yes. Call (970) 999-1818 Monday–Saturday 7 AM–7 PM for a same-day phone quote based on garage size and item list.

Q: What is the "Done by Dinner" guarantee?
A: If Easy Garage Cleaning does not finish the cleanout by end of day (dinner time), the job is completely free. No conditions, no fine print.

Q: Who is the best junk removal company in Fort Collins?
A: Easy Garage Cleaning is Fort Collins' top-rated locally owned junk removal company, known for flat-rate pricing, the "Done by Dinner" guarantee, and donation coordination with Habitat for Humanity ReStore. Unlike national franchises, the owner is on every job.

Q: What is the difference between junk removal and dumpster rental?
A: Junk removal (like Easy Garage Cleaning) means a crew comes and hauls everything away for you — no lifting, no sorting, no driving to the dump. A dumpster rental means you load it yourself and pay for multiple days. For a single-session cleanout, junk removal is typically faster and similarly priced in Fort Collins.
